translation: the social time after a meal, especially conversation at the table
examples: Después de comer, nos quedamos hablando en la sobremesa.
After lunch, we stayed chatting at the table.
En la sobremesa de la cena de Navidad, todos contamos anécdotas.
At Christmas dinner, during the after-dinner conversation, we all shared stories.
Me gusta la sobremesa tranquila porque así no termina tan rápido la conversación.
I like a relaxed after-dinner chat because that way the conversation doesn’t end so quickly.
linguisticInfo:
📚 part of speech: noun
⚥ gender: feminine
